source_preview:
Marketing Lead - Data & AI Business Line
Marketing Lead – Data & AI Business Line
Location: India (Mumbai, Pune, Chennai, Bangalore)
Type: Full-Time
Min: 15+ yrs
Role Overview
We are seeking a results-driven Marketing Lead to lead the global marketing strategy
for our Data & AI business line. This role will be responsible for positioning our
offerings, driving demand generation, enabling sales, and building thought leadership
across key markets. The ideal candidate will have deep experience in B2B technology
marketing, a strong understanding of the Data & AI landscape, and a proven ability to
translate complex solutions into compelling narratives.
Key Responsibilities
· Define and execute the global marketing strategy for the Data & AI business line
aligned with Atos goals.
· Collaborate with product, sales, and delivery teams to shape go-to-market plans and
messaging.
· Own brand positioning, competitive differentiation, and value proposition for Data &
AI services. Demand Generation & Campaigns
· Develop integrated marketing campaigns across digital, events, ABM, and partner
channels.
· Drive pipeline growth through targeted lead generation and nurturing programs.
· Monitor campaign performance and optimize for ROI. Content & Thought Leadership
· Oversee creation of high-impact content including whitepapers, blogs, webinars, and
case studies.
· Position the company as a thought leader in AI, machine learning, data engineering,
and analytics.
· Manage analyst relations and PR for the business line. Sales Enablement
· Equip sales teams with tools, collateral, and training to effectively sell Data & AI
solutions.
· Develop customer success stories and reference programs. Partner & Ecosystem
Marketing
· Collaborate with strategic partners (e.g., Microsoft, AWS, Google, Databricks) on joint
marketing initiatives.
· Leverage partner programs and co-marketing opportunities to expand reach.

Education
· 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, with at least 5 years in Data & AI or

enterprise technology.
· Proven track record in leading global marketing teams and delivering measurable
results.
· Strong understanding of AI/ML, data platforms, cloud ecosystems, and IT services.
· Excellent storytelling, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
· Experience with marketing automation, CRM, and analytics tools.
Preferred Attributes
· MBA or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field.
